status: DRAFT v1, 1 Nov 2026, not voiced. Population figures are projections; rank is by the UN WPP 2024 list on one basis.
title: Uttar Pradesh: UK-Sized Land, the World's Sixth-Biggest Crowd

beats.say: Uttar Pradesh is about the size of the United Kingdom.
beats.caption: UP ≈ UK in area (240,928 vs 243,610 km²)

beats.say: But in twenty twenty-six, it is projected to have three and a half times as many people.
beats.caption: 2026 (projected): UP ≈ 3.5× the UK's people

beats.say: That is about two hundred and forty-three million, a projection, as India's last census was in twenty eleven.
beats.caption: ≈ 243 million (projection) · last census: 2011

beats.say: Counted as a country, it would rank sixth in the world.
beats.caption: As a country: 6th in the world (UN list, 2026)

beats.say: Pakistan would be just above it, and Nigeria about level.
beats.caption: Above: Pakistan · About level: Nigeria

beats.say: In the last census, one in six Indians lived in Uttar Pradesh.
beats.caption: 2011 census: 1 in 6 Indians

beats.say: Land the size of the UK. A crowd the size of the sixth-largest country.
beats.caption: UK-sized land · 6th-largest crowd
